claims.evidence: Witness photos show a countertop kitchen appliance with a clear plastic bowl/cover and metal legs/feet labeled “EQUATOR 2”, not a handheld hair dryer.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Photos do not show purchase date, usage hours, or wear level that can confirm “barely used” or “bought new last year”.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened
claims.evidence: Photos do not show internal motor condition or whether it was opened; no test/run evidence is shown.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Item identity mismatch: seller claims hair dryer, but photos show an Equator countertop appliance with a clear bowl/cover (likely a kitchen machine). Buying the wrong category can waste money and time.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the appliance nameplate/label showing the exact product type (hair dryer vs kitchen machine) and model details, plus a photo of the included attachments that match that type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the photographed countertop appliance only (not a hair dryer), and treat it as untested/unknown function until proven.

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (no power-on test shown): could be non-functional, weak motor, or faulty speed control.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing it plugged in and running (start-up, speed/operation, and stable operation) with the bowl/cover properly fitted.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case as non-working or needing repair (as-is, untested).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/attachments: the witness saw a handle/attachment, but other parts (blades/jars/lids/filters) may be missing.
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of every included part/attachment with a checklist (blades, bowl/jar, lids, handle/attachments, any cups/jars).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/possibly missing key attachments.

risks.risk: Bowl/cover condition: clear plastic could be cracked, cloudy, or warped; internal parts may be worn or damaged but not fully visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the clear bowl/cover from multiple angles under light, plus a photo of the inside where blades/drive connect (if accessible).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming possible wear/damage to the bowl/cover and internal parts.

risks.risk: Electrical/voltage mismatch or unsafe cord: power rating/plate not shown; cord condition not fully inspectable.
risks.proof: Photo of the power rating/voltage plate and a close-up of the power cord plug and cable condition (no cuts, burns, or loose wiring).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming electrical specs are unknown and cord may need replacement.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact product type: take a clear photo of the full label/nameplate showing the appliance category (hair dryer vs kitchen machine) and exact model details.
Send a short video of the unit running (plug-in, start, and operation) showing it works properly.
Provide photos of all included accessories/attachments laid out (blades/jars/lids/filters/any cups) and confirm what is missing.
Take close-up photos of the clear bowl/cover for cracks/cloudiness and of any internal parts visible.
Show the power rating/voltage plate and close-ups of the plug/cord condition.
response.reason: The witness photos contradict the seller’s claim that it is a hair dryer and show a different Equator countertop appliance, while working condition and completeness are not proven. Proof is needed to confirm identity and functionality before pricing.
